metadata.general_model: FIFA16 absolute capability anchor + small reliability-weighted StatsBomb season adjustment
metadata.recent_model: Actual StatsBomb events from each team's five league matches immediately before the demo; recent score is a conservative adjustment around General
metadata.physical_model: Deterministic synthetic physical profile from FIFA16 pace/physic and SkillCorner A-League 2024/25 positional reference; not observed tracking data
metadata.position_policy: FIFA16/curated playable positions only; no PROFILE_FIT-only eligibility and no major structural role invention
metadata.score_range: 0-95 capability dimensions; FIFA overall retained separately
